description: NaHo(PO₃)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.76 Å. Ho is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ho-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.47 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and two longer (1.61 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.51 Å) and two longer (1.60 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.61 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and two longer (1.62 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ho and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ho and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom.
